fato_historico: 1996: ADC Airlines Flight 086 crashes into the Lagos Lagoon in Epe, Lagos State, Nigeria, killing all 144 people on board.
energia_do_dia: The cosmos invites you to find stillness within the tides of existence. Just as a ripple on a lagoon teaches us about the fragility of life, today may be a beautiful time to honor those we hold dear. Consider nurturing your spirit with gratitude and let your natural precision soften into gentle grace as you navigate your path.
frase_do_dia: Every sunrise brings a new opportunity to cherish the beauty of our delicate journey.
significado_numero: A sign of transformation and finding rhythm in the changing seasons.
conselho: Focus on the small blessings that bring lightness to your busy, organized mind.
